rules.title: Berkeley Rent Stabilization and Good Cause for Eviction Ordinance: just cause coverage
rules.requirement: Just cause for eviction applies to both fully and partially covered rental units. These include pre-1980 multifamily units, single-family homes, rooming houses, post-June 1980 new construction, and most condominiums.

unverifiable_exemptions: government-subsidized units (list truncated in the passage)
coverage.summary: The coverage guide shows Just Cause for Eviction = Yes for fully covered units (pre-1980 multifamily, single-family homes with tenancies begun before 1996, rooming houses) and for partially covered units (post-June 1980 new construction with a Certificate of Occupancy, single-family homes with tenancies begun on or after Jan 1, 1996, most condominiums).
coverage.other_conditions: Units with certain government subsidies are listed in the guide, but the passage is truncated.

rules.exemptions: The passage does not state the exemptions; the list of subsidized units is cut off.

citation_aliases: Berkeley Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance
rules.quoted_span: Most units in multifamily properties built before 1980** Fully Covered Yes Yes Yes Yes

rules.title: Berkeley owner move-in eviction relocation assistance
rules.requirement: Owners must pay tenants relocation assistance in an owner move-in eviction. The Rent Board adjusts the amounts annually for inflation. The standard payment is $19,413 and the additional payment for qualifying households is $6,471, effective January 1, 2026.
rules.key_value: Standard payment $19,413; additional payment for qualifying households $6,471; effective Jan 1, 2026 (1.5% CPI adjustment)

coverage.summary: Applies to owner move-in evictions of tenants in units covered by the ordinance.

rules.effective_date_note: The 2026 adjusted amounts take effect Jan 1, 2026. The Rent Board approved them on Oct 16, 2025. The underlying requirement predates 2026.
rules.citation: Berkeley Rent Stabilization and Good Cause for Eviction Ordinance (owner move-in relocation)
citation_aliases: Rent Board 2026 Adjustments of Relocation Assistance Payments
rules.quoted_span: The Rent Stabilization and Good Cause for Eviction Ordinance requires owners to pay tenants relocation assistance in the event of an owner move-in eviction.
rules.source_notes: Passage p8 gives the 1.5% CPI-U (SF-Oakland-San Jose) basis for the adjustment. Passage p5 says Measure BB requires annual inflationary adjustments.

rules.title: Berkeley Ellis Implementation Ordinance relocation assistance
rules.requirement: Tenants evicted so the owner can remove the property from the rental housing market (Ellis Act) receive the same relocation assistance payments as in an owner move-in eviction. The standard payment is $19,413 and the additional payment for qualifying households is $6,471, effective January 1, 2026.
rules.key_value: Same as owner move-in: $19,413 standard; $6,471 additional for qualifying households; effective Jan 1, 2026

coverage.summary: Applies when an owner removes a property from the rental market.

rules.effective_date_note: The 2026 adjusted amounts take effect Jan 1, 2026.
rules.quoted_span: The Ellis Implementation Ordinance requires the same relocation assistance payments for tenants evicted so the owner can remove a property from the rental housing market.
rules.review_note: No section number appears in the passage.
